report.answer: Core SSE/stream parsing lives in src/core/streaming.ts (class Stream<Item>, static fromSSEResponse/fromReadableStream) which parses Server-Sent Events into typed items and is used by client.post/get calls when `stream: true`. Public entry points that route into it include Responses API methods `client.responses.create()` and `client.responses.retrieve()` (both overloaded to return APIPromise<Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>> when stream:true) plus a dedicated `client.responses.stream()` helper that returns a richer ResponseStream (in src/resources/responses/) built on lib/EventStream.ts and lib/responses/. Similar patterns exist for Chat Completions (src/resources/chat/completions.ts) and Assistants (src/lib/AssistantStream.ts, ChatCompletionStream.ts) which wrap the same core Stream primitive with higher-level event emitters.
